abstract: Six cases of choriocarcinoma, 17 of vesicular mole, 20 normal pregnant females in the first trimester of pregnancy, and 20 normal nonpregnant women wih previous normal obstetrical history were evaluated quantitatively for cell-mediated immunity by response to 2:4 dinitrocholorobenzene and recall antigens. Serum immunoglobulins were estimated in all cases. Suppression of cell-mediated immunity was marked in choriocarcinoma as compared to vesicular mole. Serum IgG levels were significantly diminished in cases of vesicular mole, indicating diminished humoral immunity. Follow-up after 3 months of treatment with surgery and chemotherapy resulted in marked improvement of cell-mediated immunity.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌6例、胞状奇胎17例、妊娠初期の正常妊娠女性20例、および過去に正常な産科歴を有する非妊娠女性20例について、2,4-ジニトロクロロベンゼンおよび再刺激抗原に対する反応により細胞性免疫を定量的に評価した。血清免疫グロブリンもすべての症例で測定した。細胞性免疫の抑制は胞状奇胎に比べ絨毛癌で著明であった。胞状奇胎では血清IgGレベルが有意に低下しており、液性免疫の低下が示された。手術と化学療法による3か月間の治療後、細胞性免疫は著明に改善した。
